parameter_evidence.do_sample: Explicit official checkpoint value and author recommendation to sample.
Neutral Transformers translation of the official reference sampler: full-vocabulary softmax(logits/temperature) followed directly by multinomial sampling. These numeric neutralizers are an implementation inference, not separately quoted author recommendations.
parameter_evidence.num_beams=1: Reference implementation emits one sampled next token at each step; standard multinomial sampling translation.

limits: Five gated official generation_config files returned 401. Numeric defaults are deliberately not invented; future runs read clean local checkpoint JSON and record its hash. Local server files have not been read on this Mac.
Public source revisions document recommendations; they do not establish local weight identity or historical experiment configuration.
GPT-OSS top_k=0, min_p=None and neutral extra filters are a faithful HF translation of the official full-vocabulary reference sampler, not individually quoted author parameter recommendations.
New code is checked statically only. Actual runtime compatibility and experimental effects require the later authorized rerun.
102 core scripts include auxiliary variants; this total is not a claim that all scripts contributed paper results.
